entries.speaker: Alvin Kersh

entries.text: Mulder? What the hell are you talking about? Mulder's long gone.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Say I told Mulder that he would be killed if he stayed. Same people who threatened to kill me if I didn't go along. Would you believe that, John?
entries.speaker: Alvin Kersh

entries.text: No. Mulder wouldn't hear it, not from you, not from anybody.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: I said I told him to go. I didn't say I persuaded him.
entries.speaker: Alvin Kersh

entries.text: Oh, my god. It was Scully. Scully made him go. That's it, isn't it?
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Going to the basement?
entries.speaker: Brad Follmer

entries.text: Heard you got a stay of execution. Congratulations.
entries.speaker: Brad Follmer

entries.text: I'm sure you mean that.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: No, I'm sure the deputy director has you just where he wants you. Don't get me wrong I'm a friend to the X-Files. Kind of a comfort having you down there mr. Doggett.
entries.speaker: Brad Follmer

entries.text: Hi. Hi.

entries.text: Just so long as you know where to reach us... Mr. Follmer.
